reviews_captured_by_me.text: DNA construction was wonderful to work with from start to finish. The team paid close attention to detail and worked closely with us to make sure all of our needs were met. They were honest and very professional. We kept adding on projects while they were doing our bathroom renovation because we were so happy with their work. We highly recommend DNA construction and look forward to using them again in the future!

DNA Construction gives contractors a good name. They were detailed, completed the work on time, and were extremely professional (arriving on time each day, took pride in their work, making sure every detail was attended to, and left the house cleaned up each day.) They were also very patient and kind with minor disruptions caused by us (dog / kids / requesting redo of paint color in one of the rooms) - always with a smile. Couldn’t recommend them more highly.
